links.outcome: Accuracy of local LLM on local hospital reports vs expert audit
links.effect: Distilled Med42-8B achieved 90.91% accuracy, macro F1 0.92 (kappa 0.86) on 33 audited TMUH reports, versus 78.79% accuracy and F1 0.79 for Llama-3-8B.
links.quote: Within the audited 33-case clinical subset, the distilled domain-specific Med42-8B model demonstrated a diagnostic accuracy of 90.91% and a macro F1-score of 0.92 (substantial agreement with experts, κ = 0.86), significantly outperforming the general-purpose Llama-3-8B student model (accuracy: 78.79%, macro F1-score: 0.79).

unlisted_practices: Instruction-based distillation from a large teacher LLM into a locally deployable small language model for data sovereignty
Deterministic StopOnProperJSON output constraint to prevent generative looping
Tiered WHO logic framework as a semantic constraint on reasoning

screen.reason: Evaluates a local deployment architecture using model distillation and structured constraints (StopOnProperJSON mechanism and WHO Tiered Logic) to preserve privacy and prevent hallucinations in cancer registry abstraction.

primary.practice: local deployment / model distillation for data sovereignty
